verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a headless datacenter AI training and inference accelerator, sold as OAM/PCIe server cards for PyTorch, DeepSpeed and vLLM workloads. A creator-workstation axis covering AV1/HEVC encoding for creator apps and ISV-certified professional drivers is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Gaudi 3 shipping creator-media encoders or ISV-certified creator drivers that would make the axis apply.
